Li Shiqing.prompt_ch: 黑发黑眼的中国年轻女大学生，大约20岁左右，皮肤白皙，五官清秀。留着一头黑色长发。穿着简单的大学生服饰，蓝色牛仔衬衫搭配牛仔裤。
Li Shiqing.prompt_en: A young Chinese female university student with black hair and black eyes, approximately 20 years old, fair-skinned with delicate features. She has long black hair and wears simple university attire—a blue denim shirt paired with jeans.

Bus Driver Uncle.prompt_ch: 中年男性，大约40多岁，头发花白，身材中等，面相和善。头发有些稀疏，穿着公交车司机的制服，蓝色的衬衫。
Bus Driver Uncle.prompt_en: A middle-aged man in his 40s with graying hair, medium build, and a kind face. His hair is somewhat thinning, and he wears the uniform of a bus driver—a blue shirt.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 李诗情像往常一样在公交车上睡着了。
Plot Correspondence.en: As usual, Li Shiqing fell asleep on the bus.

Setting Description.ch: 白天, 公交车内, 安静的氛围, 座位上零散的乘客, 窗外流动的城市风景, 柔和的自然光线
Setting Description.en: Daytime, inside the bus, a quiet atmosphere, scattered passengers in their seats, flowing city scenery outside the window, soft natural lighting

Static Shot Description.ch: 李诗情坐在靠窗的座位上，头靠在窗边，表情安详，闭着眼睛，双肩包放在腿上
Static Shot Description.en: Li Shiqing sits by the window, her head resting against it, her expression peaceful with closed eyes, a backpack placed on her lap

Plot Correspondence.ch: 突然，她被一阵卡农铃声吵醒。
Plot Correspondence.en: Suddenly, she was awakened by the sound of a Canon ringtone.

Setting Description.ch: 白天, 公交车内, 安静的氛围, 座位上零散的乘客, 窗外流动的城市风景, 柔和的自然光线
Setting Description.en: Daytime, inside the bus, a quiet atmosphere, scattered passengers in their seats, flowing city scenery outside the window, soft natural lighting

Shot Perspective Design.en: Medium close up, eye level shot

Static Shot Description.ch: 李诗情微微睁开眼睛，表情有些迷茫，手伸向口袋，卡农铃声从口袋中传出
Static Shot Description.en: Li Shiqing slightly opens her eyes, her expression somewhat dazed, her hand reaching into her pocket as the Canon ringtone plays from it

Plot Correspondence.ch: 然而，公交车突然发生了剧烈的撞击，她随即晕了过去。
Plot Correspondence.en: However, the bus suddenly experienced a violent collision, and she promptly fainted.

Setting Description.ch: 白天, 公交车内, 混乱的氛围, 乘客们惊慌失措, 物品散落一地, 强烈的阳光透过窗户
Setting Description.en: Daytime, inside the bus, a chaotic atmosphere, panicked passengers, items scattered everywhere, strong sunlight streaming through the windows

Static Shot Description.ch: 李诗情身体前倾，表情惊恐，双手试图抓住前方的扶手，但失败了，头撞在前方座位上，晕了过去
Static Shot Description.en: Li Shiqing leans forward, her expression terrified, her hands attempting to grasp the handrail in front of her but failing, her head hitting the seat in front as she faints

Plot Correspondence.ch: 当她醒来时，一切似乎都很正常。
Plot Correspondence.en: When she woke up, everything seemed perfectly normal.

Setting Description.ch: 白天, 公交车内, 安静的氛围, 座位上零散的乘客, 窗外流动的城市风景, 柔和的自然光线
Setting Description.en: Daytime, inside the bus, a quiet atmosphere, scattered passengers in their seats, flowing city scenery outside the window, soft natural lighting

Static Shot Description.ch: 李诗情坐在靠窗的座位上，慢慢睁开眼睛，表情困惑，环顾四周，一切似乎都很正常
Static Shot Description.en: Li Shiqing sits by the window, slowly opening her eyes, her expression confused as she looks around—everything appears normal

Plot Correspondence.ch: 但当那该死的手机铃声再次响起时，噩梦又一次降临。
Plot Correspondence.en: But when that damned phone rang again, the nightmare returned once more.

Setting Description.ch: 白天, 公交车内, 安静的氛围, 座位上零散的乘客, 窗外流动的城市风景, 柔和的自然光线
Setting Description.en: Daytime, inside the bus, a quiet atmosphere, scattered passengers in their seats, flowing city scenery outside the window, soft natural lighting

Shot Perspective Design.en: Medium close up, eye level shot

Static Shot Description.ch: 李诗情表情紧张，手再次伸向口袋，卡农铃声再次响起，她的眼睛瞪大，显得惊恐
Static Shot Description.en: Li Shiqing's expression is tense as her hand reaches into her pocket again; the Canon ringtone plays once more, her eyes widening in terror

Plot Correspondence.ch: 公交车急转弯，乘客们尖叫着被甩下座位，李诗情也不例外。
Plot Correspondence.en: The bus made a sharp turn, passengers screamed as they were thrown from their seats, and Li Shiqing was no exception.

Setting Description.ch: 白天, 公交车内, 混乱的氛围, 乘客们惊慌失措, 物品散落一地, 强烈的阳光透过窗户
Setting Description.en: Daytime, inside the bus, a chaotic atmosphere, panicked passengers, items scattered everywhere, strong sunlight streaming through the windows

Static Shot Description.ch: 公交车急转弯，乘客们尖叫着被甩下座位，李诗情身体失去平衡，表情惊恐，试图抓住旁边伸出的一只手
Static Shot Description.en: The bus takes a sharp turn; passengers scream as they are thrown from their seats. Li Shiqing loses her balance, her expression terrified as she tries to grab an outstretched hand nearby

Plot Correspondence.ch: 她试图抓住旁边一只扶手，但失败了，后脑勺重重着地。
Plot Correspondence.en: She tried to grab a nearby handrail but failed, her head hitting the ground hard.

Setting Description.ch: 白天, 公交车内, 混乱的氛围, 乘客们惊慌失措, 物品散落一地, 强烈的阳光透过窗户
Setting Description.en: Daytime, inside the bus, a chaotic atmosphere, panicked passengers, items scattered everywhere, strong sunlight streaming through the windows

Static Shot Description.ch: 李诗情的手在空中挥舞，试图抓住旁边的扶手，但失败了，后脑勺重重着地，表情痛苦，闭上了眼睛
Static Shot Description.en: Li Shiqing's hand flails in the air, attempting to grab the nearby handrail but failing; the back of her head hits the ground hard, her expression pained as her eyes close

Plot Correspondence.ch: 第三次“醒来”时，李诗情意识到事情不对劲。
Plot Correspondence.en: Upon 'waking up' for the third time, Li Shiqing realized something was wrong.

Setting Description.ch: 白天, 公交车内, 安静的氛围, 座位上零散的乘客, 窗外流动的城市风景, 柔和的自然光线
Setting Description.en: Daytime, inside the bus, a quiet atmosphere, scattered passengers in their seats, flowing city scenery outside the window, soft natural lighting

Static Shot Description.ch: 李诗情坐在靠窗的座位上，慢慢睁开眼睛，表情困惑且凝重，手捂着头，似乎在回忆之前的“噩梦”
Static Shot Description.en: Li Shiqing sits by the window, slowly opening her eyes, her expression confused and solemn, her hand clutching her head as if recalling the previous 'nightmare'

Plot Correspondence.ch: 她试图让司机停车，但司机担心在没有站台的地方停车会出事故，拒绝了她的请求。
Plot Correspondence.en: She tried to get the driver to stop, but he refused, fearing an accident if he stopped outside a designated stop.

Setting Description.ch: 白天, 公交车内, 紧张的氛围, 乘客们好奇地看着李诗情, 窗外流动的城市风景, 柔和的自然光线
Setting Description.en: Daytime, inside the bus, a tense atmosphere, passengers watching Li Shiqing curiously, flowing city scenery outside the window, soft natural lighting

Static Shot Description.ch: 李诗情站在司机旁边，表情焦急，手抓着司机的座位，司机大叔转过头，表情犹豫，微微摇头
Static Shot Description.en: Li Shiqing stands next to the driver, her expression anxious, her hand gripping his seat. The Bus Driver Uncle turns his head, his expression hesitant as he shakes it slightly

Plot Correspondence.ch: 就在这时，手机铃声再次响起，公交车又一次出事了。
Plot Correspondence.en: Just then, the phone rang again, and the bus met with another accident.

Setting Description.ch: 白天, 公交车内, 混乱的氛围, 乘客们惊慌失措, 物品散落一地, 强烈的阳光透过窗户
Setting Description.en: Daytime, inside the bus, a chaotic atmosphere, panicked passengers, items scattered everywhere, strong sunlight streaming through the windows

Static Shot Description.ch: 卡农铃声再次响起，李诗情表情惊恐，公交车突然急转弯，乘客们尖叫着被甩下座位，李诗情也不例外
Static Shot Description.en: The Canon ringtone plays again; Li Shiqing's expression is terrified as the bus suddenly takes a sharp turn. Passengers scream as they are thrown from their seats, and Li Shiqing is no exception

Plot Correspondence.ch: 第四次醒来时，她决定扮演成一个“突发疾病”的虚弱女孩，试图让司机停车。
Plot Correspondence.en: Upon waking for the fourth time, she decided to act like a 'suddenly ill' weak girl to get the driver to stop.

Setting Description.ch: 白天, 公交车内, 安静的氛围, 座位上零散的乘客, 窗外流动的城市风景, 柔和的自然光线
Setting Description.en: Daytime, inside the bus, a quiet atmosphere, scattered passengers in their seats, flowing city scenery outside the window, soft natural lighting

Static Shot Description.ch: 李诗情坐在靠窗的座位上，表情坚定，手捂着胸口，装作虚弱的样子，慢慢站起身来
Static Shot Description.en: Li Shiqing sits by the window, her expression resolute, her hand clutching her chest as she feigns weakness, slowly standing up

Plot Correspondence.ch: 司机犹豫了一下，最终同意了。
Plot Correspondence.en: The driver hesitated but eventually agreed.

Setting Description.ch: 白天, 公交车内, 紧张的氛围, 乘客们好奇地看着李诗情, 窗外流动的城市风景, 柔和的自然光线
Setting Description.en: Daytime, inside the bus, a tense atmosphere, passengers watching Li Shiqing curiously, flowing city scenery outside the window, soft natural lighting

Static Shot Description.ch: 李诗情站在司机旁边，表情虚弱，手扶着司机的座位，司机大叔转过头，表情犹豫，但最终点了点头
Static Shot Description.en: Li Shiqing stands next to the driver, her expression weak, her hand resting on his seat. The Bus Driver Uncle turns his head, his expression hesitant, but he eventually nods

Plot Correspondence.ch: 然而，就在车子即将停下时，那可怕的手机铃声再次响起，公交车又一次出事了。
Plot Correspondence.en: However, just as the bus was about to stop, the dreadful phone rang again, and the bus met with another accident.

Setting Description.ch: 白天, 公交车内, 混乱的氛围, 乘客们惊慌失措, 物品散落一地, 强烈的阳光透过窗户
Setting Description.en: Daytime, inside the bus, a chaotic atmosphere, panicked passengers, items scattered everywhere, strong sunlight streaming through the windows

Static Shot Description.ch: 车子即将停下，卡农铃声再次响起，李诗情表情惊恐，公交车突然急转弯，乘客们尖叫着被甩下座位，李诗情也不例外
Static Shot Description.en: The bus is about to stop when the Canon ringtone plays again. Li Shiqing's expression is terrified as the bus suddenly takes a sharp turn. Passengers scream as they are thrown from their seats, and Li Shiqing is no exception

Plot Correspondence.ch: 李诗情不甘心，她发誓下一次一定要先抓紧什么，避免再次受伤。
Plot Correspondence.en: Li Shiqing refused to give up. She vowed that next time, she would hold onto something tightly to avoid getting hurt again.

Setting Description.ch: 白天, 公交车内, 安静的氛围, 座位上零散的乘客, 窗外流动的城市风景, 柔和的自然光线
Setting Description.en: Daytime, inside the bus, a quiet atmosphere, scattered passengers in their seats, flowing city scenery outside the window, soft natural lighting

Static Shot Description.ch: 李诗情坐在靠窗的座位上，表情坚定且不甘心，手紧紧握拳，眼神中透露出决心
Static Shot Description.en: Li Shiqing sits by the window, her expression resolute and unwilling to concede, her hands clenched into fists, her eyes filled with determination

Plot Correspondence.ch: 李诗情紧盯着前方，准备迎接下一次的挑战。
Plot Correspondence.en: Li Shiqing stared ahead, ready to face the next challenge.

Static Shot Description.en: Li Shiqing sits by the window, leaning slightly forward, her expression focused and determined, her hands gripping the handrail tightly, ready to face the next challenge
